cancellation.heading: Cancellation policy
cancellation.refundNote: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.
cancellation.changeNote: Date changes are free if requested 7+ days before the trip.

items.title: No Alcohol or Smoking
items.description: Consumption of alcohol and smoking is strictly prohibited during the trip. Violation may result in immediate termination without refund.

items.title: Dinner Before Boarding
items.description: Please have your dinner before boarding the vehicle. We won't stop for dinner breaks during night journeys.

items.title: Travel Arrangements
items.description: We use Tempo Travellers or Mini-buses with push-back seats. Travel will be AC or NON AC based on conditions.

items.title: Know your trip
items.description: Review the itinerary, accommodation, activity level and inclusions for this trip. Contact our team if you need more details.

items.title: Food (Vegetarian/Non-Vegetarian)
items.description: All meals provided during the trip are vegetarian/Non-veg based on the situation.

items.title: Leave No Trace
items.description: Respect nature. Don't litter, don't pluck plants, and carry back all your waste. Let's keep our trails clean.

items.title: Personal Belongings
items.description: Team Weekend Trekkers is not responsible for loss or damage to personal belongings. Keep valuables secure at all times.

items.title: Potential Delays
items.description: Travel times are estimates. Traffic, weather, and unforeseen circumstances may cause delays. Please be patient and cooperative.

items.question: How do I book a trip?
items.answer: Choose a departure and traveller count, then continue to checkout. Pay by scanning the QR code or copying the UPI ID, and report your payment for manual review. Your place is confirmed only after our team verifies payment and availability. If a trip offers a booking-request option, you can use it to check availability before paying.

items.question: Is there a WhatsApp group for the trip?
items.answer: Yes! Once your booking is confirmed, you'll be added to a WhatsApp group with fellow travelers and the trip coordinator 2-3 days before the trip.

items.question: Is it safe for solo travelers?
items.answer: Solo travellers are welcome. Ask us about the group, accommodation and trip difficulty before booking.

items.question: Is it safe for women travelers?
items.answer: Contact us about accommodation arrangements, coordinator support and any specific concerns before booking. Follow the coordinator’s instructions throughout the trip.

items.question: Are there any discounts available?
items.answer: If coupon entry is available at checkout, apply your eligible code to view the discounted total before payment. Ask us on WhatsApp about current offers. Your booking is confirmed after our team verifies payment and availability.

items.question: What should I pack for the trip?
items.answer: Pack light! Essentials include: comfortable clothes, good walking shoes, rain jacket/poncho, water bottle, power bank, personal medicines, toiletries, and a small backpack.

items.question: What if I need to cancel my booking?
items.answer: You can cancel through WhatsApp. Cancellation fees apply: 25% fee (6+ days before departure), 50% fee (4–5 days before departure), and 100% fee (0–3 days before departure). Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days.

items.question: What if the trip gets cancelled due to weather?
items.answer: If we cancel due to bad weather or unforeseen circumstances, you'll get a full refund or option to reschedule to another date. Your safety comes first!
